subject: General Updates
detail: Bajaj Auto Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Change in Corporate Office Address of Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) of the Company i.e. KFin Technologies Limited.

subject: Press Release
detail: Bajaj Auto Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 26, 2026, titled "Bajaj WEGO sets a record of 394.2 km on a single charge and becomes the first electric three-wheeler to complete the Kashmir-to-Kanyakumari journey."
